files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- Updated to latest Nextcloud app template
- Require Node.js 20+
- Supported Nextcloud versions: 31-32
- Added translations for finnish and german
### Fixed
- Widget link logic (#15, ported from #8)
